name: pinebridge-mt5
description: Pinebridge: TradingView alerts to MetaTrader 5. Send TradingView alerts straight to MetaTrader 5 on your own Unraid server. No paid signal-relay service, no VPS. This container is the MetaTrader 5 side: it runs a full Windows 11 VM (dockur/windows, KVM/QEMU) that installs MetaTrader 5 and the TradingViewZeroMQExecutor EA by itself on first boot -- no files to download. First boot takes roughly 15-70 minutes (Windows download + install, then MT5 setup); watch it via the WebUI. Requires /dev/kvm on the host (enable virtualization in BIOS) and your own Windows license for anything beyond evaluation use. Places real trades automatically: read the risk notice (https://github.com/jakeshake/pinebridge/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md) and test on a demo account first.

paths.name: Storage
paths.description: Persistent Windows VM disk image (keep this on cache/SSD if you can)

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: noVNC web viewer -- watch/control the Windows desktop in a browser

ports.name: ZMQ Port
ports.description: ZeroMQ port the EA listens on -- pinebridge-bridge connects to 172.17.0.1 (this server, from Docker) or :this port

variables.name: MT5_SERVER
variables.description: Your broker's MT5 server name, exactly as shown in MT5 (e.g. MetaQuotes-Demo)

variables.name: MT5_SYMBOL
variables.description: Chart symbol the EA attaches to on startup (the EA trades whatever symbol each signal names)

variables.name: CPU_CORES
variables.description: CPU cores allocated to the VM

variables.name: USERNAME
variables.description: Windows account username (not your broker login)

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.description: Windows account password (not your broker login) -- change this
